The home secretary has hailed the expanded use of immigration enforcement teams, and claimed they will help to secure the UK’s borders by removing a key incentive for irregular migration. DLS calculates targets using resources, meaning overs remaining and wickets in hand together. The VJD method is the only serious modern rival, and it is used in Indian domestic cricket. Earlier systems failed because they ignored wickets, most notoriously at the 1992 World Cup. The Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method is the system cricket uses to reset a target when rain or any other interruption shortens a limited-overs match. It was devised by two English statisticians, Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis, introduced in 1997 and adopted by the ICC two years later.

stories.title: Thomas Müller thinks Jürgen Klopp can bring ‘clarity’ to Germany
stories.summary: The former FC Bayern star thinks Klopp will bring the best out of Germany. Müller sees Klopp as an interesting blend of modern and old-school coaching, with experience managing superstar players in the Premier League while also developing young talent. However, he believes Klopp's biggest challenge will be restoring something Germany has gradually lost: its identity, mentality, and ability to make life miserable for opponents. Müller also feels Germany has become too focused on playing attractive soccer without being decisive enough when it matters.
